title: 1RB0RE_0RC0RF_1LD1RA_1RE0LD_0LB1RC_1LE---: the rebuild law checked for every word by a symbolic case analysis; no transient halts
text: Between groups of the counter's bits the transient after a rebuild stops at one of ten frontier shapes, each a family with at most two parameters. A symbolic engine (affine parameters, runs of any length, the history as an unknown number, loops taken at once by induction) runs every shape on every group value: 516 cases, none halts, and the shapes reproduce the 7-state automaton exactly; the start and the 27 end cases give the law's counter. So the machine can halt only if a transient reaches the top of the counter or a list too short for it. A Python check, tested against the rebuild map on 1,000 random rebuild states; not yet in Lean.
